one_liner: CivicState needs paid-demand, deliverability, and identity validation before it is investible.
directive: Use BUSINESS.md as the current EIR plan, but do not upgrade authority until operator merge and validation gates clear.
authority: POM soul-review + wrk.dog merge constitute adoption - operator ruling 2026-06-12; see the PR's POM record

methods: Read existing planning and implementation artifacts.
Separated repository evidence from unverified external market claims.
Tagged all commercial sizing, conversion, and valuation claims as assumptions.

planningMethod: Bottom-up validation plan: paid submissions x package AOV, then deliverability, coverage, citation quality, and support-load gates.

customer.definition: U.S. resident with a civic concern who wants researched, citation-backed constituent letters sent to the right officials.
customer.primaryICP: Individual constituent, not enterprise advocacy buyer.

market.sam: $15,000,000 [assumption: 1,000,000 digitally reachable, letter-suitable jobs x $15 AOV]
market.method: Bottom-up volume assumptions multiplied by repository-evidenced pricing tiers.
market.freshness: As of 2026-06-19 [assumption: worker current date], no external market research was performed.

businessModel.aov: $15 [assumption: tier mix centered on three-official package]

revenueAssumptions: 1,200 paid submissions in 2026 validation year [assumption: modeled scenario]
6,000 paid submissions in 2027 operating year [assumption: modeled scenario]
24,000 paid submissions in 2028 scale year [assumption: modeled scenario]
costAssumptions: $1.50 variable cost per paid submission [assumption: modeled scenario]
$625/month base fixed cash cost in 2026 [assumption: modeled scenario]
$150,000 headcount cash cost in 2028 [assumption: modeled scenario]
sensitivityTests: 1% preview-to-payment conversion likely fails the business [assumption: modeled scenario]
$3.00 variable cost lowers gross margin to 80% [assumption: modeled scenario]
Below 70% .gov accepted delivery should pause growth [assumption: modeled scenario]
20%+ human-review rate breaks the one-operator model [assumption: modeled scenario]

alternatives: Manual emails, phone calls, and government contact forms [assumption: modeled scenario]
Quorum / VoterVoice / FiscalNote-style advocacy suites [assumption: modeled scenario]
General AI drafting plus manual send [assumption: modeled scenario]

holes: Do not pitch as near-term investible until operator confirms this is a business, not only a research asset.
Do not scale traffic before .gov deliverability and official coverage are measured.
Do not add social, coalition, subscription, or certified-mail scope before paid letter delivery works.
mitigations: Run 25 paid non-affiliated submissions before broad launch [assumption: modeled scenario].
Run 100 ZIP code official-coverage audit [assumption: modeled scenario].
Require legal-adjacent operator/counsel review before public paid launch [assumption: modeled scenario].
residualRisks: Government mail systems may suppress generated letters.
Citation verification or legal-adjacent boundaries may fail under real use.

strategy.current: Validate the paid CivicState loop, then decide investibility and platform posture.
strategy.positioning: Individual constituent communication utility, not legal advice, not a lobbying firm, not a petition social network.
strategy.moat: Verified officials directory, bounce/response history, citation library, and opt-in public campaign archive [assumption: only compounds with volume].

goToMarket.firstMotion: Founder-led paid beta with local civic groups, operator networks, and issue-specific communities [assumption: modeled scenario].
goToMarket.first100Customers: Direct recruitment and manual concierge support for first 100 paid submissions [assumption: modeled scenario].
goToMarket.scaleMotion: SEO from opt-in public campaign pages only after delivery works [assumption: modeled scenario].
channelsToAvoid: Enterprise sales before individual loop works

operatorWorkflow.routine: Review flagged submissions, monitor bounces, reconcile ledger, inspect failed jobs, and maintain official contacts.
operatorWorkflow.oneOperatorAssumption: One operator can handle launch volume [assumption: unvalidated].
operatorWorkflow.failureTrigger: Human-review rate above 20% [assumption: modeled scenario] requires scope or pricing change.

constraints: Registry note: Watchlist; personal/research asset; not near-term investible BOS unless operator confirms.
Civic/legal-adjacent sensitivity: avoid legal advice, claim filing, harassment, defamation, and unverified legal conclusions.
Project identity mismatch: dispatch says brooks-history / brookss-history; repo implements CivicState.
metrics: Accepted delivery / inbox placement, target 85%+ [assumption: modeled scenario]
Official coverage, target 95%+ federal/state and 60%+ local [assumption: modeled scenario]
Human-review rate and minutes per flagged case
Gross margin, target 88%-92% [evidence: MASTER_PLAN.md; assumption: actuals unknown]

rules: Every quantitative market or financial claim must retain evidence or assumption labels.
AI disclosure appears in generated letters [evidence: apps/worker/src/agents/drafter.ts].
Unverified citations are stripped or flagged [evidence: apps/worker/src/lib/legal/citation-verifier.ts].
Threats and high-risk content are blocked or flagged [evidence: apps/api/src/lib/moderation.ts].
limitations: No production legal review is present.
No production model-quality report is present.

unknowns: Whether public campaign SEO can acquire users
